metadata.title: Multiplicity of sign-changing solutions to higher-order $Q$-curvature equations
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we employ the dual cone method to establish the existence of infinitely many sign-changing solutions to the $Q$-curvature problem involving $GJMS$-operators of arbitrary order $m$ on closed Riemannian manifolds of dimension $n > 2m$, under the assumptions that the operators are coercive and positivity-preserving and that the manifold admits appropriate symmetries. To demonstrate the applicability of our framework, we provide explicit examples on both closed Einstein manifolds and closed special Einstein products. Notably, one of the major contributions of this work is deriving explicit conditions that guarantee the coercivity of $GJMS$-operators on closed special Einstein products.
